challenger_governance: any future challenger requires a separate contract/model generation/evaluation program and may not use the consumed WP8 holdout as its promotion benchmark

champion.preprocessing_spec: VALUE_SPEC (median impute, indicator=True, percentile clip, robust scale; fitted training-only)

economic_shadow.benchmark: SPY canonical total return (same reconstruction as target_set_d2bb16610bce)
economic_shadow.cost_interpretation: single entry-side deduction from cohort 12m return (cost_bps/10000); benchmark unadjusted; report all scenarios

eligibility.missing_handling: record excluded securities and exclusion reasons; never silent drop
eligibility.preprocessing_rule: use frozen preprocessor VALUE_SPEC exactly; no new live-data imputation

immutability.correction_policy: operational/data-ingestion defect only, discovered before outcomes mature; original preserved as INVALIDATED_OPERATIONAL_NON_EVIDENTIARY; new corrected snapshot; explicit supersession; Quant Auditor approval required; never because ranks look wrong

pit_rules.corporate_actions_reconstruction: apply actions with effective_date in (target_start, target_end]; raw close reconstructed, never provider-adjusted
pit_rules.feature_fundamental: SEC acceptance datetime, else filing_date + 1 day; never fiscal period end
pit_rules.feature_price: trade date + conservative market close UTC

prospective.maturity_rule: snapshot matures only when target_known_at per target_set_d2bb16610bce availability semantics is <= evaluation run date
prospective.official_snapshot_rule: first full monthly scoring date (last eligible trading/score date) strictly AFTER this contract's freeze commit timestamp; no backdating; no official snapshot may be backfilled

ranking.calibrated_rank_equivalence: frozen Platt logistic transform is strictly monotonic, so calibrated rank is equivalent

scientific.primary_metric: equal_weighted_mean_monthly_auc_skill (cross-sectional ROC-AUC per matured monthly snapshot minus 0.5, equal-weighted across months)

stage_a.trigger: at least 3 consecutive valid official monthly snapshots generated

stage_b.action: first prospective interim review; report predeclared metrics; NO champion change

stage_c.action: first major prospective statistical gate; do not shorten

sources.replacement_policy: Data Integrity Engineer must review any proposed replacement source before Builder implements it

universe.membership_rule: S&P 500 membership effective as-of T only; use effective_date (conservative instant); never future/current membership to reconstruct older snapshots
